company.description: Canopi is a speciality agency that is specifically focused on cultivating brand/blogger relationships. We make it easy and seamless for brands to find the right bloggers and work with them on a large scale. Through our network of 2500+ bloggers we’re able to run influencer and digital marketing campaigns heavily focused on mid-sized bloggers. Our goal is to revolutionize how consumers hear about brands in today’s noisy environment. We pride ourselves on creating authentic and long lasting relationships with bloggers so that brands can get the right message to the right people at the right time.
